description: The Nechí River blockade (E003) is an actual public action, but the opened report’s 500-person figure describes a group on strike and does not prove 50+ people simultaneously gathered at one location. The demand primarily concerns access to land worked by a private company; the public-policy target is unclear. Exact start and end are unknown.
required_followup: Seek a permitted contemporaneous account, interview/official record or later independent report that states who gathered at the river, simultaneous site count, the exact state-policy demand, and the action’s end; do not use company workforce or mining association membership as crowd size.

description: The 28 Feb Fecode/ADE Bogotá march and petition filing occurred, but the available live report gives no simultaneous attendance at any single site. Delegations, teachers represented and union membership cannot substitute for the crowd count.
required_followup: Search permitted local Bogotá and sector-specific reporting published on 28 Feb or retrospective coverage for a single-site estimate and event close; keep pending_threshold until demonstrated.

description: ASOINCA demonstrations continued at the Capitolio into February and ended after a government agreement on 20 Feb, but exact prior-month start/sequence and any 50+ gathering are not established. Search-only results claim a 16 Jan strike start and describe a 7 Feb entry attempt.
required_followup: Use permitted body sources to confirm the exact start date, whether the Capitol encampment and Feb7 confrontation were a continuous episode, local simultaneous crowd size and precise return/end date; do not create a February onset event.

description: The 15 Feb Medellín gathering is excluded at the nationally organized campaign level because a contemporaneous Infobae report explicitly connects party-promoted opposition marches with electoral contest and names at least two parties. However, S015 is pre-event reporting and does not verify party groups physically present at every local site; local differentiation remains possible.
required_followup: Review whether the national organization and common policy positions justify applying the rally exclusion to the Medellín gathering; if not, keep the local gathering as a candidate, using the documented qualitative hundreds and reform demands, without a national headcount.

description: Open-web coverage is non-exhaustive. Spanish and English searches, targeted by the first/second half of February and specific dates/sectors, found activity in Barranquilla, Bogotá, Medellín, Manizales, Valledupar, the Nechí River and Magdalena Medio. No systematic print/archive search or LexisNexis access was available; the English query mostly returned Spanish results. Follow-up to the La Lizama humanitarian commission scheduled for 13 Feb was not established as a new public protest.
required_followup: Before claiming bounded coverage, search feasible regional/local press for Feb1-13 and Feb16-27, the 13 Feb La Lizama commission follow-up, and single-city attendance around 14/15/28 Feb; retain monthly source limitations.
